text: 👀 Size Limit: A JavaScript Performance Budgeting Tool Set a size or load-time budget for your code and this tool can fail CI (or flag a PR) if a change goes over it. You can also do one-off checks and see visualizations of where the bytes are. Framework-agnostic and doesn’t care which bundler or CI you use. Andrey Sitnik

CHALLENGE const compose = (...fns) => fns.reduce((f, g) => (...args) => f(g(...args))); const pipe = (...fns) => fns.reduce((f, g) => (...args) => g(f(...args))); const add1 = x => x + 1; const double = x => x * 2; const square = x => x * x; const composed = compose(square, double, add1); const piped = pipe(square, double, add1); console.log(composed(3), piped(3));

🤩 The Grand Unifying Architecture of Frontend SolidJS's creator argues that HTMX, React, LiveView, and friends differ mostly in how they split the same three jobs (navigation, content, and instant UI feedback) between client and server. He then shows how Solid 2.0 aims to cover the whole spectrum. Ryan Carniato

😮 How Anthropic Made Claude's Apps 3x Faster in Two Weeks A grab bag of performance lessons from a sprint that cut p75 'time-to-typeable' from 3.1s to 0.55s. Em dashes (the irony!) pushed V8 onto a slower regex path, a stray location.reload() caused half a million hidden reloads a day, and more. Wang, Attard, and G (Anthropic)

CHALLENGE const arr = [1, 2, 3]; const log = []; const result = arr.map((x, i) => { if (i === 0) arr.push(4); log.push(x); return x * 2; }); console.log(result.join(','), log.join(','), arr.join(','));
